name: Adam Wathan
role: Creator of Tailwind CSS · Refactoring UI
bio: Adam Wathan is the creator of Tailwind CSS and co-author of Refactoring UI with Steve Schoger. His personal site describes full-stack teaching through articles, talks, and courses, with Tailwind as the primary focus since working on it full-time beginning in 2019. Public materials teach practical UI design from a developer’s point of view.
highlights: Creator of Tailwind CSS; co-author of Refactoring UI.
Public teaching via adamwathan.me articles and courses.
Utility-first composition technique (visual tips remain on Schoger).
